messages:
Rina S.: Hi everyone — quick question: my calendar shows tomorrow's orientation but the event tile has no join link. anyone else? :confused:
Onboarding Bot: Hi Rina! Official Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/777888999 (passcode: `Welcome-RI`). If your event lacks the link, you probably have a duplicate invite; accept the one from People Ops and decline the other. ICS: https://redwood.app/ical/onboard.ics :calendar:
Tom H.: I had two invites too (team + onboarding). Accept People Ops and delete the duplicate. Outlook sometimes keeps a ghost event — sign out/in or clear cache to fix.
Rina S.: thanks — timezone sanity check: Zoom is 09:00 PT right? i'm in CET.
People Ops: Correct — 09:00 PT = 12:00 ET = 17:00 UTC = 18:00 CET. We'll post a small conversion table in the event and pin it in this channel.
Rina S.: will it be recorded and where will we find the recording?
Onboarding Bot: Yes, recorded. Recording + transcript will be uploaded to Drive (New Hires > Sessions) and linked here in #new-hires within ~1 hour after the session. If you can't attend live, RSVP "No" and we'll send the recording.
Tom H.: Heads-up for APAC: we'll pin conversions for SGT/AEST/NZDT/IST. Also breakout rooms are pre-seeded by team; breakout audio isn't included in main transcript.
Rina S.: perfect. last tiny thing — my calendar tile reads "Guests can't join" even though i'm internal. is that expected?
People Ops: That's just the event privacy label. Guests can join via the Zoom link regardless. If anyone actually gets blocked when joining, DM us immediately and we'll escalate with IT.
Rina S.: accepted the People Ops invite and see the link now. Thanks all :wave:
